title: Evaluation-compatible external duality respects a structural comparison
statement:
Use finite coefficients $A=A_{E,n}$, correspondences $c:C\to X\times_kX$ and $\bar c:\bar C\to\bar X\times_k\bar X$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and a cohomological pre-comparison $(f_Z,t_Z,\alpha_g,\beta_g,\iota)$ with notation $r_Z,d_Z,\delta_Z,j_Z,\Pi$ as in [def-trf-cohomological-comparison]. Assume axioms (I)--(V) of that definition, the exceptional tensor identity (a), tensor-unit identity (c), and dualizing projection identity (d) displayed in [lem-trf-cohomological-evaluation-calculus]; the latter identities are hypotheses here, without requiring compactifiability. All exceptional operations and complexes used are in the admissible finite-Tor constructible domains of [def-trf-admissibility]. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ put $K'=f_XK$ and
$$P=K\boxtimes D_XK,\quad Q=f_XK\boxtimes f_XD_XK,\quad\bar P=K'\boxtimes D_{\bar X}K',\quad J=1\boxtimes d_X:Q\to\bar P,$$
$$V=R\mathcal Hom(p_2^*K,p_1^!K),\quad\bar V=R\mathcal Hom(\bar p_2^*K',\bar p_1^!K'),\quad\theta=R\mathcal Hom(\alpha_{p_2},\beta_{p_1})\circ r_{X\times X}:f_{X\times X}V\to\bar V.$$
Here $D_X$ is Verdier duality [def-trf-dualizing-complex], the $p_i$ and $\bar p_i$ are the two product projections, and $\kappa:P\to V$, $\bar\kappa:\bar P\to\bar V$ are exactly the evaluation-defined maps of [def-sf-kv-maps](iv). Then
$$\theta\circ f_{X\times X}(\kappa)\circ\Pi_{K,D_XK}=\bar\kappa\circ J:Q\longrightarrow\bar V.$$
This identity holds whether or not $\Pi_{K,D_XK}$ is invertible; it compares the maps before cancellation and has no trace-class conclusion.
